scope: Bayer dir3 refinement of the current autonomous HL4/DR7 engine, no language rewrite. Legacy retained. D40 and postponed point 6 excluded.
changes: The Bayer two-surface fit may handle axis-aligned boundaries only when both adjacent rows/columns contain an original nonsaturated sample within the same 13x13 window. Recovered HL values alone cannot locate a hidden boundary.

Retain directional reconstruction when every missing-channel difference is within the existing plane-fit tolerance 0.001 * max(abs(low),abs(high),0.01). Oblique/curved admission, HL4 recovery, DR7 and camera profiles unchanged.
Only missing CFA channels are replaced; acquired samples remain assigned directly. Original clipping provenance is bit-packed before WB and included in DNG/NEF memory plans.
Core owns the dir3 recipe string; tr-raw references it directly. Probe/decode/job/cache identities cannot drift through separately maintained literals.
Frozen dir2 reference preserves BR6 reproducibility; BR7 and the HL4/dir2 comparator identify baseline, candidate and source hashes explicitly.

changes_after_fresh_measurement.render.rs: Clippy iteration cleanup: identical channel order and assignments; no numerical model change.
changes_after_fresh_measurement.lib.rs and core/decoder.rs: Single recipe definition in core, dir3, used by RAW and cache.
changes_after_fresh_measurement.research/quality.rs and photographic.rs: Report identifies frozen dir2 baseline and hashes the Bayer source; no pixel calculations changed.
changes_after_fresh_measurement.apps/desktop/src/cache/artifact.rs: Test-only extension of persisted-cache regression: old dir2 descriptor and pixel blocks are valid but cannot be read by dir3, at requested or reduced resolution. No production cache behavior changed.

fresh_analytical_validation.repeated_measurement_role: Reproducibility, not a second independent holdout.
fresh_analytical_validation.limits: Three analytical transforms, all four Bayer phases, two axes, central/border cuts, colour changes, affine fields, texture, noise and curved edges. Phases, regions and shared truths are correlated; 456 records are not 456 independent camera observations. No physical targets or calibrated profiles.

baseline_integrity.HL2_comparison_scope: Follow-up of the 59 previously listed peak comparisons against their frozen HL2 comparator; not an exhaustive fresh HL2 campaign.

common normalized chromaticity maximum absolute error

example_identity_note: IDs such as d750-step-cool-p0 recur across historical generators with different dimensions and parameters. Compare only records with the same source/truth hashes and regions; HL and legacy campaign numbers must not be mixed by label.

development.role: Reused regression corpus, validation split already consumed.

consumed_validation_split.role: Reused regression corpus, validation split already consumed.

demosaic_regression.photo_scope: 225 fixed crops from 25 previously measured GB82 photographs, four Bayer phases and two noise levels. Already rendered RGB remosaicing; no new independent sensor or camera colour truth.

legacy_comparison.scope: Reused 124-case Bayer regression; identical RAW/truth/geometry/WB/recipes for legacy, no exposure fitting, no fresh independent legacy holdout. Compatibility matrices used to synthesize and interpret input are not physical camera truth. One decode per engine is functional evidence only, not timing qualification.
legacy_comparison.common_chroma_rule: Both engines measured on the same explicitly valid pixel intersection with truth, without exposure matching.
legacy_comparison.limits: Legacy still wins some rejected/ambiguous boundaries and fully clipped neutral references. Its neutralization is an assumption, not a measured recovery of coloured lights. Counts are overlapping region/metric comparisons, not independent scene wins.

remaining_tracked_HL2_peaks.scope: Follow-up of the previously flagged 59 comparisons only, not a new exhaustive HL2 comparison.

fully_clipped_ambiguity.scope: Fully clipped fields with no informative contour cannot identify neutral versus coloured light. These pairs do not test fully clipped components with informative surroundings.

timing.scope: Same process, same input bytes, same native geometry and gains; two source versions with identical opt-level=3/LTO=thin, alternating order. Input read and input/output hashing excluded; allocation, parse, unpack, HL, demosaic and matrix included. Warm OS caches; no IPC or GUI, no thermal control. One-repeat entries check full-output equivalence only.
limits: No concurrent test/build/GUI campaign; ordinary OS background activity not controlled.
One D750 input with 30 repetitions, D800 14-bit and RAF with 10 each, three warmups per method and alternating order.
Other five inputs have one pair, no performance inference.
Warm OS caches; file read/hash, IPC and GUI excluded, no thermal/cold-start control.
10-sample p95 is a coarse nearest-rank estimate. No general speed superiority claim.

memory.additional_Bayer_provenance_bytes: ceil(sensor_pixels / 8), or zero allocation if no clipped codes
memory.limits: Reserved buffer accounting and single functional RSS observation; not a hard cap or demonstrated overall RSS improvement.

open: 48 previously tracked local peak comparisons remain worse than HL2 on 21 scenes; no denoising or profile adjustment to hide them.
Some legacy advantages remain on rejected edges and full saturation without informative surroundings; original measurements do not uniquely identify the missing colour.
Camera-measured profiles, physical targets and illuminants, physical saturation below the digital ceiling, extended independent sensor/photo verification and sufficient X-T5 registration remain open.
Memory-pressure, global release/security/quality gates remain open. No new formats, D40, fuzz or Windows work in this increment.
